debugData.name: Rules scatter block
debugData.description: p308 Phase 3's block: a 64 m rulesTerrain block behind the flat one, rock (layer 1) in its vertex colours from 22° of slope (about 37 % of it), sand (layer 0) on the flats, its HEIGHTFIELD collider from the generator. Its scatters are the toolkit's terrainScatter: pebbles on the rock, slabs with CONVEXHULL colliders on the sand.
